import Lean
import Imported.GenesisOngoing.Second.Rename
open Lean Elab Command in
#eval show CommandElabM Unit from do
  let env ← getEnv
  match env.getModuleIdx? "Imported.GenesisOngoing.Second.Rename".toName with
  | none => IO.println "MODULE-NOT-FOUND"
  | some idx =>
    let cited : Array String := #["Seed.Second.Reach.rename", "Seed.Second.Reach3.rename", "Seed.Second.ReachNoRemove.obstruction_persists", "Seed.Second.ReachNoRemove.toReach", "Seed.Second.Step.rename", "Seed.Second.Step3.rename", "Seed.Second.costA_rename", "Seed.Second.costB_rename", "Seed.Second.exists_perm_of_ne", "Seed.Second.fewest_changes3_every_writing_A", "Seed.Second.fewest_changes3_every_writing_B", "Seed.Second.fewest_changes_every_writing_A", "Seed.Second.fewest_changes_every_writing_B", "Seed.Second.legal_rename", "Seed.Second.lostA_rename", "Seed.Second.lostB_rename", "Seed.Second.mem_rename_A", "Seed.Second.mem_rename_T", "Seed.Second.merge_rename", "Seed.Second.miss_rename", "Seed.Second.obstruction_persists_reach", "Seed.Second.rename_a", "Seed.Second.rename_addAssertion", "Seed.Second.rename_addTerm", "Seed.Second.rename_b", "Seed.Second.rename_givenA_arb", "Seed.Second.rename_givenB_arb", "Seed.Second.rename_givenB_bra", "Seed.Second.rename_id", "Seed.Second.rename_identify", "Seed.Second.rename_remove", "Seed.Second.rename_rename", "Seed.Second.rename_symm_apply", "Seed.Second.result_iff_A", "Seed.Second.result_iff_B", "Seed.Second.size_rename", "Seed.Second.wf_rename"]
    let names := env.header.moduleData[idx.toNat]!.constNames
    let mut anyMiss := false
    for s in cited do
      -- a cited symbol resolves to a constant whose full name is the symbol or ends in "." ++ symbol (the
      -- evidence map's rule). All matches are printed; the driver treats a leaf with several matches and no
      -- exact one as ambiguous, and a symbol with no match as unresolved. No other fallback.
      let mut hit := false
      for n in names do
        let ns := n.toString
        if !n.isInternal && (ns == s || ns.endsWith ("." ++ s)) then
          hit := true
          let axs ← collectAxioms n
          IO.println s!"AX\t{s}\t{ns}\t{axs.toList.map toString}"
      if !hit then
        anyMiss := true
        IO.println s!"UNRESOLVED\t{s}"
    if cited.isEmpty || anyMiss then
      -- extra information only: every user-facing theorem the file declares. It never sets the pass flag of
      -- a row whose cited symbols include one that did not resolve.
      for n in names do
        if !n.isInternal then
          match env.find? n with
          | some (.thmInfo _) =>
            let axs ← collectAxioms n
            IO.println s!"AX\t*\t{n.toString}\t{axs.toList.map toString}"
          | _ => pure ()
